entities.name: The Gathering Dark
entities.description: First novel of the Ice Age Cycle by Jeff Grubb, telling the origin of Jodah.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Young wizard-in-training destined to be a great pioneer of magic on Terisiare; great-grandson of Jarsyl.

entities.name: Voska
entities.description: Jodah's mentor, killed by the Inquisition.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: Wizard of the City of Shadows who helps Jodah.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Leader of the Conclave of Mages who usurped control from Lord Ith.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Founder of the Conclave of Mages, caged and drained by Mairsil.

entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: Entity summoned by Ith to bring someone to free him.

entities.name: Primata Delphine
entities.description: Leader of the Inquisition following Jodah.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Jodah's great-grandfather, famous for a journey to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Rival school of magic led by Mairsil.

entities.name: Inquisition
entities.description: Church of Tal's force prosecuting wizards.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent in ruins after the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: Battle in which goblins and giants slaughtered both armies.

entities.name: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Destruction of the Conclave after the Inquisition's attack.

events.summary: Jodah is captured by the Inquisition, who kill his mentor Voska, and flees to Alsoor.
events.quote: First, he is captured by the Inquisition, who killed his mentor Voska .

events.summary: Jodah joins the army and survives the Battle of Pitdown by hiding in a Fountain of Youth.
events.quote: he has to hide in a Fountain of Youth to avoid being killed by goblin raiders

events.summary: Jodah meets Sima; their ship is hit by a storm and Jodah is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man, who leads him to the Conclave of Mages.
events.quote: he falls overboard and is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man

events.summary: Jodah discovers Mairsil has usurped the Conclave from Lord Ith and keeps him caged to drain his powers.
events.quote: Mairsil has usurped control of the Conclave from its founder, Lord Ith

events.summary: The Inquisition led by Primata Delphine attacks the Conclave and the mages defeat them.
events.quote: they launch a huge attack on the Conclave

events.summary: Jodah and Sima free Ith, who kills Mairsil and then is restored by seeing his reflection in Jodah's mirror.
Ith leaves on his own; Jodah and Sima take the remaining wizards from the destroyed Conclave to the City of Shadows.
events.quote: Ith decides to leave and be on his own

relations.note: Ith kills Mairsil after being freed.

relations.quote: Jodah has been joined by Sima, and together, the two of them free Ith
Mairsil has usurped control of the Conclave from its founder, Lord Ith
